              Ichiros Malt Chichibu x Komagatake (Mars) Double Distilleries 2021 53.5% 70cl

              £269.95

              Was £299.95 Save £30.00

              We are delighted to introduce our single cask Chichibu. Our very first exclusive Japanese whisky, Cask 8238 is an 8 year old single malt, distilled on the 20th of July 2017 from heavily peated concerto barley. Matured in a first-fill ex-bourbon barrel, and bottled at cask strength. Only 183 bottles in the world, selected exclusively for us.

              The label was designed by Raj Chavda specially for this bottling, and it is beautiful. An intricate, golden illustration that nods to our shop on the Royal Mile.   Here are thoughts from our Spirits Buyer Sam: When the opportunity came up to select our first ever exclusive Japanese single malt, it was an easy yes. Chichibu is one of the most admired names in modern whisky for good reason, we have huge respect for their whisky-making which is done with such consistency and clear affinity for traditional single malt styles. Bottled exclusively for our customers, this cask immediately impressed us. The combination of heavily peated Concerto barley and first-fill bourbon maturation has produced something with Chichibu's spirit at its core that's hugely enjoyable. An elegant peated distillate with enticing cask influence offering an assortment of confectionary and beach bonfire characters.  With only 183 bottles drawn from the cask, it’s a small release and one we’re very excited to share.

              Official Tasting Notes

              Nose: Notes of barbecued pineapple and cinder toffee, along with earthy peat.

              Palate: The palate offers a rich, full bodied texture with bright citrus and ashy smoke before finishing with a lingering incense smoke.

              Shipping and delivery

              Order before 2pm on a working day and we’ll dispatch your order the same day, with next working day delivery across the UK.

              UK delivery is free on orders over £100. For international orders, delivery costs are calculated at checkout based on your destination.

              You’ll find all the details, including delivery rates and destinations, on our Delivery & Returns page.

              Billing

              We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Payment is taken securely when you place your order.

              Our prices include UK VAT where applicable. We also show the ex-VAT price alongside the main price, so our trade and export customers can easily see both.

              Returns

              Changed your mind? No problem. You have 14 days from delivery to let us know you'd like to return your order. 

              Please take care when handling and packaging your return, as the condition of the product and its packaging can affect the amount we’re able to refund. If your order arrives damaged or faulty, please get in touch with us and we’ll put things right.

              For the full details, see our Terms and Conditions.

              Our Stores

              Prefer to pick up your whisky? Click & Collect is free from either of our Edinburgh shops - Royal Mile Whiskies or Drinkmonger in Bruntsfield.

              Choose Click & Collect at checkout and we’ll email you as soon as your order is ready to collect. You can find opening hours, addresses and directions on Our Shops.
